summary: theforeman.foreman breaking changes: content_view_filter no longer manages rules (use content_view_filter_rule), and the inventory plugin no longer defaults to http://localhost:3000, so a URL is required.
questions: Why does my Foreman inventory fail without a URL?
How do I manage content view filter rules in theforeman.foreman?

answer_card.title: theforeman.foreman breaking changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- `content_view_filter` no longer manages rules. Use `content_view_filter_rule`.
- The inventory plugin no longer defaults to `http://localhost:3000`, so you must set the Foreman URL.
